heading_path: Part 8—Amendment, cancellation and revocation of registration
text: When the Registrar amends any particular entered in the Register in respect of a trade mark, the Registrar may also amend the certificate of registration if he or she thinks it appropriate to do so.
title: Amendment of certificate of registration
